meta.source: Read from in-game Trainer Tree tooltips at beta.poke-nexus.com
notes: pathCost = cheapest total points from the start node, matches the in-game "Path: N points" readout
levelReq is the trainer level shown on gated nodes; keystones need 30, Shiny Bond needs 50
x/y are layout coordinates relative to the start node (screen units at default zoom, y down)
edges are undirected; 13 short cross-links ("rungs") join neighbouring lanes inside a branch
stats[].max is the cap for each bonus; capSource says whether it was confirmed in game or is just the sum of every node for that bonus
Keystone stats (keystone:true) are counted toward the same capped totals; whether a keystone penalty applies before or after the cap still needs checking in game

nodes.effect: +5% encounter rates in a region once you've caught every Pokemon that spawns there, Commons to Extremely Rares. Legendary encounters don't count, and neither do boss floors, Deep maps, the Faraway Islands, Ancient Dungeon or Altering Cave (no bonus there either). [shows per-region dex progress]

nodes.name: Encore
nodes.effect: For 30 minutes, the species you last battled replaces the other Pokemon of its rarity wherever it spawns. Rare, Very Rare and Extremely Rare Pokemon only, not legendary ones. Cooldown 4 h.

nodes.name: Regroup
nodes.effect: Teleport to a party member. You need to have been there or have as many badges as they do, plus any ticket or key item the way in asks for. You can't reach someone who is surfing without Surf, and Regroup never goes into Elite Four rooms. Cooldown 30 min.
